info.title: PolyMigrate — multilingual website migration tool
info.description: A .NET tool for migrating a legacy multilingual website (PHP, ASP, any CMS) to a static site. Mirror HTML becomes frontmatter Markdown for Hugo, Eleventy or Astro; language versions are paired automatically (hreflang, slugs, shared media, dates) and what cannot be paired is listed for review; 301 redirect maps are written for nginx, Netlify and Cloudflare Pages; links, media and redirects are verified offline. Config-driven and re-runnable offline.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
polymigrate thumbs <config.yaml> [--root <dir>] [--media <dir>] [--out <dir>]
Generate thumbnails: media/ -> media_thumb/ (same layout). EXIF auto-orient,
downscale to media.thumbnails.max_width; animated GIF/WebP keep every frame
(up to 50 megapixels of frames; bigger ones, or ones that would grow, get the
first frame). Existing thumbnails are skipped.
polymigrate probe-orphans <config.yaml> --section <name> --years <from-to>
[--lang <prefix>] [--root <dir>] [--out <file>]
Probe the live site for orphan pages (removed from indexes but still served):
per-day slugs in both YYYYMMDD and MMDDYYYY forms, plus A-D suffix variants.
Polite (site.polite.delay_ms) and sends site.auth_workaround cookies.

options.name: --out
options.description:
Exits 1 when only some probes got no usable answer (the list may be incomplete),
2 without writing the list when none did.
polymigrate fetch-orphans <config.yaml> --section <name> [--slugs <file>] [--root <dir>]
Fetch probed orphan pages (all langs) into raw/ and their assets into media/.

options.name: --slugs
options.description:
wrote for the same --section (one slug per line).
polymigrate verify <output-dir> [--media <dir>] [--media-prefix /media/]
[--allow-unlinked <file>] [--redirects <file>]
Verify extracted output: frontmatter fields, internal links, media refs,
and unlinked pages — pages no other page links to, which visitors can
only reach by typing the URL. Unlinked pages are warnings.
Default media dir: <output-dir>/media (media checks skipped if absent).

options.name: --redirects
options.description:
_redirects file): missing targets, chains, loops, conflicting rules.
polymigrate slugs <root> --section <name> [--lang <prefix>] [--raw <dir>]
List slugs already mirrored under <root>/raw, sorted, one per line on stdout
(the summary goes to stderr, so stdout stays pipeable). During a
parallel run: diff this against the live site's current list, then
feed the difference to fetch-orphans --slugs. Local only, no network.
polymigrate templates <config.yaml> [--root <dir>] [--raw <dir>] [--out <dir>]
Group mirrored pages by layout skeleton before writing the config: per template,
how many pages and sections, how much text extract.content captures, and a
suggested content selector. Writes template_report.csv and template_pages.csv
to --out (default <root>). Exits 1 when extract.content captures nothing on
some pages. Local only, no network; content/ is not touched.
polymigrate --help, -h              Print this help
polymigrate --version, -v           Print version
